articles.title: OAuth flow
articles.body:
## Overview

Authorization code flow with PKCE.

## Steps

1. Client creates `code_verifier`
2. Redirect to IdP with `code_challenge`
3. Exchange code for tokens

```bash
curl -X POST /oauth/token
```

## Notes

- Prefer **public clients** with PKCE
- Store refresh tokens securely
articles.author: Alice Chen
